name: Microblog Stream
author: Bonumark
description: A dark, compact, orange-accented personal microblog theme with declarative Profile, Stream Card, and Home layouts, the classic status/count header, and Following and Conversation presentation for Bonumark Stream v0.8.1.

show_page_updated_date.description: Display the updated date under public page titles. Off by default.

menu_label.description: Text used for the public navigation toggle.
